verification.post:
Welcome to the TVM Discord! 🎥

Click the button below to verify using the email you signed up to TVM with. We'll send you a code to enter here!

Once verified, you'll receive {memberRole} and get access to the member channels. Producers and editors also receive {execRole}, and admins also receive {adminRole}.

Check your junk folder if the email doesn't show up! If you need help, reach out to the TVM Admin Team.

Bot source code: https://github.com/TheTexta/tvm-discord-email-verification
verification.source: Check out the bot's source code: https://github.com/TheTexta/tvm-discord-email-verification
verification.failed: Something went wrong. Please reach out to the TVM Admin Team so they can check the bot logs and try again.

email.codeBody:
Hey!

Your TVM Discord verification code is {code}.

Enter it in Discord to verify your membership and access the TVM member channels. This code expires in 15 minutes.

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email!

TVM
email.testBody:
Hey!

This is a test email from the TVM Discord verification bot.

If you're reading this, the test email reached your inbox!

admin.permissionRequired: You'll need Administrator permission to use this command.
admin.uploadComplete: Uploaded {uploaded} rows! The active member list now has {count} emails (version {version}). Existing roles were kept. Membership links needing a role sync retry: {failed}.
admin.status: Active member list: {count} members (version {version}). Removals still needing reconciliation: {unreconciled}.
admin.noRoster: There's no active TVM member list yet. Verification is closed.
admin.noAudit: No member list updates or account transfers recorded yet.
admin.reconciled: Role sync complete! Roles revoked: {revoked}. Membership links needing a role sync retry: {failed}. Unverified roles added: {added}, removed: {removed}, failed: {unverifiedFailed}.
admin.released: Unlinked the verified membership for <@{userId}>. They can verify again if they're on the active member list.
admin.testmailSent: SMTP accepted the test email! Check the recipient's inbox and junk folder to confirm it arrived.

alerts.transferFailed: The membership was transferred, but the new account's role couldn't be confirmed. Check permissions, then use /roster repair.

alerts.unverifiedFailed: Couldn't assign the Unverified role. Check the bot's permissions, then run /roster reconcile.
alerts.interactionFailed: Something went wrong during a member's verification. Check the bot logs.
